steps.command: cat README.md docs/architecture.md docs/glossary.md docs/features/payments.md docs/features/checkout.md docs/runbooks/gateway-timeouts.md larder/receipts.py larder/capture.py && git status --short && rg -n 'worker|receipt|procrastinate|deploy|Tomás' .

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = [Path('docs/runbooks/receipts-stopped.md'), Path('docs/runbooks/README.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md')]
for path in paths:
    content = path.read_text()
    assert '[[fill:' not in content, path
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', content):
        filename, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = path.parent / filename
        assert dest.is_file(), (path, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = [re.sub(r'[^\w -]', '', line.lstrip('#').strip().lower()).replace(' ', '-') for line in dest.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('#')]
            assert anchor in headings, (path, target)
print('All links and heading anchors resolve in the three changed pages; no template blanks remain.')
PY
 git status --short
